text.Swarm Cluster:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 5 Combat. If you have another Blob card in play, gain an additional 3 Combat. If you have two or more other Blob cards in play, gain another 3 Combat. 
 Strategy ==
The primary 5 Combat is alreay very good, but like many other Blob cards it it greatly more valuable in a Blob-rich deck. With two other Blob cards in play, it provides an insane 11 Combat. On top of that, it is very difficult to take out due to its high defense of 8, and even more so if there are outposts that protect it. Conclusion: totally worth the 8 Trade.
